## Purpose

Import or compute metabolic activity scores in AnnData and save the updated `.h5ad`.

::: {.callout-note}
## Archive status

This is a legacy notebook kept for reference. For current reusable workflows,
see the active templates in the repository.
:::

## Packages

Load the packages needed for this notebook.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
import os
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
```

## Parameters

Set the parameters that control the analysis and output locations.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object = "path/to/previous_step.h5ad"
activity_file = "path/to/metabolic_activity.tsv"
output_object = "path/to/metabolic_activity.h5ad"
results_dir = "results/metabolic_activity"
figures_dir = "figures/metabolic_activity"
sample_column = "sample_column"
group_column = "group_column"
cell_column = "cell_id"
features_of_interest = ["pathway_1", "pathway_2"]
seed = 1
```

## Inputs

Load the input object or tables used by the workflow.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
os.makedirs(results_dir, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(figures_dir, exist_ok=True)
adata = sc.read_h5ad(input_object)
activity = pd.read_table(activity_file)
```

## Validation

Check the required inputs before running the analysis.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
if cell_column not in activity.columns:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing activity cell column: {cell_column}")
missing = {sample_column, group_column}.difference(adata.obs.columns)
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing obs columns: {sorted(missing)}")
activity = activity.set_index(cell_column).reindex(adata.obs_names)
```

## Input Summary

Record a compact summary of the inputs for later review.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
pd.DataFrame({"n_cells": [adata.n_obs], "n_activity_features": [activity.shape[1]]}).to_csv(f"{results_dir}/metabolic_input_summary.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
```

## Analysis

Run the main analysis with the parameters defined above.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
for column in activity.columns:
    adata.obs[column] = activity[column].values
adata.uns["metabolic_activity_features"] = list(activity.columns)
```

## Diagnostics

Inspect the checks that help assess the analysis output.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
activity.describe().T.to_csv(f"{results_dir}/metabolic_activity_summary.tsv", sep="\t")
```

## Visualization

Save the main diagnostic or result figures to the output directory.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
for feature in [x for x in features_of_interest if x in adata.obs.columns]:
    sc.pl.umap(adata, color=feature, save=f"_{feature}.png", show=False)
```

## Object metadata

Store the derived metadata alongside the analysis object.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
adata.uns["template"] = {"step": "metabolic_activity", "activity_file": activity_file}
```

## File outputs

Write the tabular outputs produced by this workflow.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
adata.obs[[sample_column, group_column] + list(activity.columns)].to_csv(f"{results_dir}/metabolic_activity_by_cell.tsv", sep="\t")
```

## Save

Save the resulting object in the format used by this notebook.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
adata.write_h5ad(output_object)
```

## Output summary

Summarize the files and objects written by the workflow.

```{python}
#| label: tpl-scrna-10-metabolic-activity-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
print({"output_object": output_object, "activity_features": activity.shape[1]})
```
